finalText:
**The build works now.** One real error, hiding under about 900 lines of noise.

`src/core/settings.js` read a bare `retries` that was never defined, so the link step crashed with `ReferenceError: retries is not defined`. The comment right above it said the value should come from the caller with a constant fallback, so that's what it does now.

```
build finished in 41.7s with 3 warnings, 0 errors
```

The 3 warnings are still there and are real, but none of them break anything:

| Code | What | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| W1042 | old `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| W2213 | `formatLegacyDate` exported, unused | `src/utils/format.js` |
| W3307 | two files import each other | `src/core/graph.js`, `src/state/tracker.js` |

Those three files aren't in this folder, so I left them alone. Happy to chase them if you point me at the real source tree.
